title: 🔥 My First Ever Chicken Curry at 50! 🔥
paragraphs: 🔥 My First Ever Chicken Curry at 50! 🔥
Believe it or not, mga higala, at 50 years old, I just cooked my very first Chicken Curry! 😆 (Better late than never, di ba?)
At first, I was like “Lord, tabang! Unsay first step?” Then I remembered, “Ah, PRAY first before you SLAY!” 🤣

As I cooked, my kitchen turned into a House of Prayer:
☑️ “Lord, let this chicken be tender.”
☑️ “Lord, may the coconut milk not betray me.”
☑️ “Lord, I rebuke burnt onions in Jesus’ name!”

And guess what? My family LOVED it! When they said:
💛 “Pa, lami kaayo! We love it!”
My heart was full, murag I just received a divine calling sa cooking ministry!

I can only imagine… when I finally face God and He says:
"Well done, my good and faithful servant." (Matthew 25:23)
Ahh, the JOY of being appreciated—whether sa luto o sa kinabuhi!
Here’s my heavily prayed-for Chicken Curry Recipe:

🔸 Ingredients:
🐔 1 kg chicken (baptized in prayer)
🥥 1 can coconut milk (anointed)
🥔 2 potatoes (cut with love)
🥕 1 carrot (for a balanced diet, char)
🧅 1 onion (para sa drama)
🧄 4 cloves garlic (pang-likay sa temptation)
🫑 1 bell pepper (extra flair)
🫙 2 tbsp curry powder (the secret weapon)
🧂 Salt & pepper (because life needs seasoning)
🔥 Cooking oil (for anointing the pan)
🙏 1 full prayer before starting

🔹 Instructions:
1️⃣ Pray first—important!
2️⃣ Sauté onion and garlic until aromatic (like worship rising up).
3️⃣ Add chicken and cook until golden brown (para crispy sa grace).
4️⃣ Pour coconut milk, then simmer.
5️⃣ Add potatoes, carrots, and bell pepper.
6️⃣ Sprinkle curry powder—Hallelujah moment!
7️⃣ Season with salt and pepper, then let it simmer until perfect.
8️⃣ Serve with rice, then receive compliments with grace!
Moral lesson: Age doesn’t matter when you’re willing to learn. Whether in cooking, life, or faith—we can always start fresh!
Kinsa pa diha ang nagtuon pa lang pagluto? Let’s laugh together. 😆🙌
